newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Physician fails to pay $78 million debt.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Physician fails to pay $78 million debt.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc. said Monday it has failed to pay about $78 million in outstanding debt, which matured on Feb. 28.
The physician management company's stock fell 25 cents to $2 on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was among the day's biggest percentage losers.
Coastal, based in Durham, N.C., said it was nevertheless making "progress" in talks with its lenders.
"Active discussions continued through the weekend on a possible extension of the maturity date of the outstanding indebtedness beyond July 1, 1997 and on additional financing," it said.

The company said it had also made "progress" with another lender about its financing needs. "However, there can be no assurance that additional funds will be provided by either the existing lenders or an alternate financing source," it said.
On Feb. 5, the company said operating losses, divestitures of non-core businesses and principal repayments to its lenders had reduced cash flow to meet cash operating requirements.
Coastal provides a broad range of health care and administrative services to physicians, hospitals, employers, managed care programmes and other health care providers.
